conviction_note: Today's -6.5% on 0.47x volume is day four of unwinding a +104% speculative 20-day run-up. The cause, purchasers in the $24.0m PIPE priced near $1.18 missing the 9/29 funding date, was public on 9/30. Nothing dated lands before the 10/2 close. The one live in-window line is supply: a $100m H.C. Wainwright ATM, effective since 8/31, can sell into any bounce. So p_up is 45 on an abs move of 9 (ATR 29%, recent next-day moves median about 10%), which gives -0.9.
bar: Two sources. The name's own 178 comparable falls: median next close -1.62%, 41.6% up, median abs 4.8%. The cross-section: under-2x volume +1.46%, high ATR continues. Both from the sealed baseline research/2026/10/2026-10-01/reversal/baselines/INDP.json. There is no option chain.

cause.label: dilution_or_going_concern
cause.what_happened: INDP ran from about $1.17 (9/2) to a 52-week high near $5.96 on the 9/10 $24.0m PIPE and a neurotech/sleep-device pivot. It has fallen four sessions running (-14.6%, -13.4%, -19.3%, now -6.5% at 15:04 ET). The 9/30 8-K disclosed that the purchasers had not delivered their subscription amounts by the 9/29 outside date and that closing had been extended to 10/16. Today's leg comes on half-normal volume with no new filing.

evidence.claim: On 9/29 Notices and Consents extended the PIPE outside date from 9/29 to 10/16. The company waived termination for purchasers' failure to deliver subscription amounts by 9/29.
Kalkine reported the extension, no reason given and purchasers unnamed.
9/8 stock purchase agreement: 20,338,974 shares for ~$24.0m at the Nasdaq Minimum Price +$0.015, with resale registration rights. Proceeds may go to a neurotechnology sleep device.
On 9/29 the stock fell 24.4% to $2.85 with no verified reason, before the 8-K became public.

pipeline.next_dated_event: PIPE Extended Outside Date 2026-10-16 (after the window). Short-interest settlement 9/30 publishes about 10/9 (after the window). Nothing dated inside the window.
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: An 8-K before the 10/2 close showing the PIPE funded and closed, or the ATM suspended or terminated, would remove the supply lean. A termination 8-K would deepen it.

positioning_check: Short interest 916,352 shares at the 2026-09-15 settlement, up 331.5% from 212,357 on 8/31, with days to cover 1.0 on 2.31m ADV (Nasdaq https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/INDP/short-interest?assetclass=stocks). That is before the fall; the 9/30 settlement is not yet published (about an 8-business-day lag). Float is roughly 153m shares outstanding: about $360m market cap at $2.35 per a stockanalysis snippet, against 133.2m at 6/30 in the 424B5. No options market, so no skew. Insiders: 0 trades in 3 months, 5 open-market buys in 12 months.

findings.finding: A $100m at-the-market program with H.C. Wainwright is open and effective. The A&R agreement is dated 8/28/2026, the 424B5 was filed 8/31 and amended 9/4, under an S-3 effective 8/20/2025. The company can sell into the 10/2 session at about 2x the $1.14 the prospectus assumed, while its own PIPE funding is stalled.
findings.mechanism_in_window: An effective ATM can be drawn on any trading day, including 10/2. No further filing or pricing event is needed, so the supply sits inside the window rather than after it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not directly observed. ATM sales are only disclosed in the next 10-Q, estimated 11/11 per the Zacks cadence, which is not company-announced. The 4/1 amendment stated no shares had yet been sold under the prior supplement as of 9/4.
findings.why_not_priced: The close prices the PIPE scare, which is in the past. It does not price an issuer with about $11.6m cash at 6/30 (8/13 release), a stalled $24m PIPE and a $100m shelf-backed ATM, which can meet any bounce with supply on 10/2. If that were priced, a bounce would get no follow-through. This is an inference about use, not a disclosed sale, so it carries a small weight.
findings.independence: The 9/30 8-K shows the alternative funding route (the PIPE) is not yet funded, which raises the incentive to use the ATM: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1857044/000149315226045040/ex10-1.htm

outside_window.finding: PIPE of 20.3m shares at ~$1.18 must fund by the Extended Outside Date of 10/16, or purchasers and the company may terminate. Funding adds shares far below spot, with resale registration rights (future overhang). Failure removes $24m of runway from a company with ~$11.6m cash. Unresolved, with the sign set by which way it resolves.
Resale registration for the 20.3m PIPE shares, required after closing, puts shares bought at about $1.18 into the market at about $2.
DECOY20 Phase 1 (NCT05651022) is active, not recruiting, with primary completion 2027-06-30. Combination-study enrollment was discontinued per the 8/13 release.

searched_and_found_nothing: No news or filing dated 2026-10-01 explains today's leg. WebSearch 'Indaptus INDP October 1 2026' and the stocktitan news page (latest item 8/13) returned nothing. The EDGAR submissions list in the baseline shows the latest filing as the 9/30 8-K.
No disclosed ATM sales: the 9/8 8-K/A and the amended 424B5 say none sold as of 9/4. Nothing later is public.
No reason for the PIPE funding delay and no purchaser names in the 9/30 8-K or EX-10.1 (efts full-text 'Extended Outside Date' returns only that filing).
Repricing leg: no analyst note, no Form 4 buyer, no index event, no wrong wire fact, and no exhausted-volume close (0.47x volume). No mechanism exists, so no overshoot finding was filed.
The 9/4 8-K item 5.02 is the resignation of director Tim Ruan, no disagreement. Not relevant to the window.
Quote snippets (stockanalysis/investing 9/30 prices) appeared in search results. All were dated at or before 9/30. Nothing after the screen instant was seen or used.

baseline_tension: This partly cuts against the baseline. The under-2x volume base rate (+1.46%) and the name's history of violent rebounds (+22%, +29% in September) argue up. ATR 29%, a 41.6% up-rate over 178 comparable falls, and the unresolved PIPE and open ATM argue down. That is why p_up stays near 50 (45) rather than lower.
